# Neuro & Evil Karaoke API — Explore

Base URL: https://api.neurokaraoke.com (Production)

Discovery data for the Explore page: trending songs, genre overview, cover artist distribution and contributor credits.

### `GET /api/explore/trendings` — Get trending songs

Auth: none

Returns the most played songs over the last `days` days. `take` sets the number of results, from 1 to 100 (default 100). Values above 100 are capped at 100. Results are precomputed and cached, so they may lag behind live play counts.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `days` | query | `int` | no |  |
| `take` | query | `int` | no | default: 100 |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  id: string | null
  title: string | null
  opus: string | null
  oss: string | null
  cnPath: string | null
  absolutePath: string | null
  playCount: int | null
  duration: int | null
  streamDate: date-time | null
  dateAdded: date-time | null
  coverArtists: string[] | null
  originalArtists: string[] | null
  genres: string[] | null
  coverArt: {
    id: string | null
    fileName: string | null
    contentType: string | null
    description: string | null
    isAnimated: bool
    credit: string | null
    cloudflareId: string | null
    mediaStorageType: int  // Possible values: `0` = Blob, `1` = Cloudflare, `2` = Badge
    absolutePath: string | null
    artist: {
      id: string | null
      name: string | null
      socialLink: string | null
      userId: string | null
      arts: object[] | null
    }
    upvotes: int
    tagString: string | null
    mediaTag: int  // Possible values: `0` = Neuro, `1` = Evil, `2` = Twins, `3` = Hiyori
  }
  thumbnailArt: { …same as `coverArt` above }
  order: int
  hasLyrics: bool
  userUploaded: bool
  videoId: string | null
  hls: string | null
}[]
```

### `GET /api/genres/explore` — Get the genre overview

Auth: none

Returns all genres with the summary data shown on the Explore page.

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  id: string | null
  name: string | null
  songCount: int
}[]
```

### `GET /api/stats/cover-distribution` — Get cover artist distribution

Auth: none

Returns the number of songs per cover artist across the whole library.

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  totalSongs: int
  neuroCount: int
  evilCount: int
  duetCount: int
  otherCount: int
}
```

### `GET /api/credits` — List contributors

Auth: none

Returns the people credited for contributing to the site (uploads, art, metadata, etc.).

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  name: string | null
  credit: string | null
  isArtist: bool
}[]
```
